{{Quote|Hey soldier, I need a volunteer for an important job. You want to make some credits?|Lieutenant Erlem Marh, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FWDC" />}}
'''Erlem Marh''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I need you to pull some guard duty outside the walls to keep the enemy from waltzing in our front door.|Lieutenant Erlem Marh, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FWDC" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Erlem Marh was present on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] when an [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|accident]] took place in the [[Imperial Research and Prison Facility]].<ref name="SWG:FWDC" /> The [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] that was studied there escaped containment and decimated most of the people in the area, turning them into starving [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] creatures. In response, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] promptly established a [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] to contain the infection.<ref name="SWG:MMR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Mysterious Meeting Request|Dathomir}}</ref> The few people who survived the initial virus outbreak, including Lieutenant Marh,<ref name="SWG:FWDC" /> were trapped in the Quarantine Zone. The survivors established camps in order to to repel the regular assaults of the zombies and try to live in safety while waiting for an evacuation.<ref name="SWG:MMR" /> Stephon Erlem Marh took shelter in [[Camp Delta]], along with [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[TR-522]]<ref name="SWG:DR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Deliver Radio|Dathomir}}</ref> and the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Oona Wran]].<ref name="SWG:DCACD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Destroy Canisters Around Camp Delta|Dathomir}}</ref> Lieutenant Erlem Marh was in charge of the forward defense of the camp and used to recruit spacers who ventured into the Quarantine Zone to help him in that mission.<ref name="SWG:FWDC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Erlem Marh was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FWDC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Erlem Marh was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|Game Update 14]]," a.k.a. the [[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|"Death Troopers" update]], released on [[October 12]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>
